name: wine_reviews
description:
Classify the variety of wines based on tasting descriptions from sommeliers, and numeric
    features like price and categorical features like country-of-origin. The original version of this dataset
    was collected from WineEnthusiast: https://www.kaggle.com/zynicide/wine-reviews
  
 Dataset found from the paper: Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
creator: Xingjian Shi, Jonas Mueller, Nick Erickson, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
citation: Shi, X., Mueller, J., Erickson, N., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. (2021). Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
